title: Inspect categorical association cell by cell
outcomes: Use the chi_square adapter to address: Are species and sepal-width band associated, and which observed-versus-expected cells support the conclusion?
Explain one observation with linked analytical evidence and an explicit limitation
Repair and transfer the interpretation while preserving reproducibility

tasks.prompt: State why one observation in a built-in R teaching dataset is the unit of observation, identify each variable role, and restate the question: Are species and sepal-width band associated, and which observed-versus-expected cells support the conclusion?
criteria: Defines the unit of observation and variable roles
Connects the data to the stated question

tasks.prompt: Predict which category combinations may appear more or less often than expected under independence.
tasks.criteria: Records a falsifiable expectation before inspection

tasks.prompt: Build the contingency table, run chisq.test(), and connect observed counts, expected counts, and standardized residuals.
tasks.criteria: Connects visible R source to the compiled artifact

tasks.prompt: Compare cells in the semantic table and 2D plot, prioritizing large absolute standardized residuals.
tasks.criteria: Selects an observation using a stable evidence ID

tasks.prompt: Identify a contributing cell, compare observed with expected count, and state an association-not-causation limitation.
criteria: States an assumption or causal limitation

tasks.prompt: Check expected counts and remove claims that every cell or every individual follows the omnibus pattern.
tasks.criteria: Corrects the identified evidence or assumption problem

tasks.prompt: Apply observed-versus-expected reasoning to a different contingency cell.
criteria: Keeps the interpretation within its evidence boundary

tasks.prompt: Verify the analysis source, seed, R and package versions, evidence hash, and retained-row decision before sharing the lesson.
tasks.criteria: Verifies source, seed, version, retained rows, and artifact hash

analysis_recommendations.label: Describe one numeric variable
analysis_recommendations.reason: Starts with center, spread, percentile, and distribution evidence for one numeric variable.
analysis_recommendations.caution: A sample summary describes retained observations; it does not establish a population value.

analysis_recommendations.label: Explore numeric dimensions
analysis_recommendations.reason: Safest starting point for describing observations without adding a model.
analysis_recommendations.caution: Describe patterns only; visible proximity does not establish causation.

analysis_recommendations.label: Correlation with paired evidence
analysis_recommendations.reason: Connects a correlation estimate to the paired observations that produced it.
analysis_recommendations.caution: Correlation measures paired association, not causation; inspect form, outliers, and dependence.

analysis_recommendations.label: Bootstrap a sample mean
analysis_recommendations.reason: Uses resampled means to make sampling variability and interval interpretation visible.
analysis_recommendations.caution: A bootstrap interval reflects the observed sample and resampling rule, not every source of uncertainty.

analysis_recommendations.label: Compare two group means
analysis_recommendations.reason: Select a numeric outcome and a grouping variable with exactly two levels.
analysis_recommendations.caution: Interpret the mean difference with its interval, assumptions, design, and practical importance.

analysis_recommendations.label: Analysis of variance
analysis_recommendations.reason: Select a numeric outcome and a grouping variable with at least two levels.
analysis_recommendations.caution: A significant omnibus F test does not identify which groups differ or establish causation.

analysis_recommendations.label: Chi-square association
analysis_recommendations.reason: Compares observed and expected counts for two categorical variables.
analysis_recommendations.caution: Inspect expected counts and standardized residuals; association does not establish causation.

analysis_recommendations.label: Principal component analysis
analysis_recommendations.reason: Available when the question is about summarizing shared variation across numeric variables.
analysis_recommendations.caution: PCA summarizes variance and requires score, loading, scaling, and variance evidence.

analysis_recommendations.label: Linear regression
analysis_recommendations.reason: Select a non-binary numeric outcome and at least one numeric predictor.
analysis_recommendations.caution: Use a grouped or longitudinal model for inferential work.

analysis_recommendations.label: Binary logistic regression
analysis_recommendations.reason: Select a two-level outcome and at least one numeric predictor.
analysis_recommendations.caution: Use a grouped or longitudinal model for inferential work.

analysis_recommendations.label: K-means clustering
analysis_recommendations.reason: Available when the question is explicitly about tentative groups in standardized numeric data.
analysis_recommendations.caution: Scale variables, use multiple starts, and check whether conclusions change across k or seed.

authoring.warnings: Grouped or repeated observations were declared. Core lm/glm adapters do not model dependence, so regression is not automatically recommended.

context.question: Are species and sepal-width band associated, and which observed-versus-expected cells support the conclusion?
context.unit_of_analysis: one observation in a built-in R teaching dataset
context.decision_context: statistical reasoning practice, not a causal or population claim

diagnostics.label: Contingency cells
diagnostics.interpretation: Observed and expected counts are linked cell by cell.

diagnostics.label: Smallest expected count
diagnostics.interpretation: Small expected counts can make the chi-square approximation unreliable.

diagnostics.label: Chi-square / p-value
diagnostics.interpretation: Use standardized residuals to locate cells contributing to the omnibus association.

cautions: Association between categorical variables does not establish causation.
Expected-count assumptions and the sampling design must be checked.
The data declare grouping by width_band. Core lm/glm adapters do not model this dependence; treat inferential results as instructional until an appropriate grouped or longitudinal model is used.
authoring.misconceptions: A significant chi-square result does not mean every cell differs meaningfully from expectation.
